dct_description_sm: Appears to be an etched, probably unauthorized copy of an edition of Ortelius's map, possibly made in Italy. This map copies the re-engraved clouds in lower left corner, which, according to Shirley, dates the map to 1579 or later. The word "occidens" on the left edge of the map reads bottom to top rather than top to bottom as in the original. On laid paper with a watermark of a bunch of grapes.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
LC copy trimmed, with narrow right and bottom margins. Left margin also cut away in lower corner.
